correctness.rationale: The allowed negation and clipped shifts preserve a finite max-of-mins representation by constant pieces and clipped signed unary literals with intercepts in d^-1 Z. For each clause and hidden variable the maximum of min positive and negative clipped slopes is at an endpoint or their crossing (b-a)/2, in G_(2d), independently of all retained valuations. Finite max commutes with sup; inf follows by negation. The unique crossing for f_d(x)=min(x,S_(k/d)(1-x)), k=0,1,2 according to parity, has reduced denominator exactly 2d. All quantifiers are finite-variable and the result is purely propositional, not modal. Independent exact rational evaluation of 1,440 random signed-literal clauses d=1..8 matched half-grid maxima; this checks examples, not all terms.
residual_risks: This does not give modal uniform interpolation, bound formula size, or allow arbitrary binary truncated addition.
